ProxyLane upstream TLS certificate verification

rustls-platform-verifier 0.7.1
https://github.com/rustls/rustls-platform-verifier
Used under the MIT license (LICENSE-rustls-platform-verifier.txt).

webpki-root-certs 1.0.10
https://github.com/rustls/webpki-roots
Mozilla public CA certificates, generated from CCADB.
CDLA-Permissive-2.0 (LICENSE-webpki-root-certs.txt).

The versions are pinned in src/ProxyLaneMitm/Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock.
Review public-root additions/removals and update the bundle with software
releases. The bundled roots are not installed in the Windows certificate store.
